chapter: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

quests.title: Lights, Kamera, Action!

dialogue.t: Look, look, {NICKNAME}! There's a Kamera here, and some props too. D'you think this is a film set?
But these houses... they're so tiny. They make you look like a giant!
Rawr... Rawrrr!

dialogue.sit: This would make a great house for you, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Rawrrr...
Hehe, looks like we're real "big" shots now, huh?

dialogue.sit: Suddenly, yet utterly seamlessly, a Natlan local joins the conversation...

dialogue.t: Oh, hello! Are you guys interested in filmmaking too? If so, then I beseech you — join forces with me, Akatanga, to bring this burgeoning new trend to the lands of Natlan, that it might sweep all before it!
Rawr! Raaaawr!
How come you're so hyped all of a sudden, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Anyone'd think you were a film buff yourself, chiming in like that!
Raaaawrrr!
You have a keen eye, little one! In truth, everything you see here was set up with the sole intention of making a certain little Tepetlisaur the next big star!

A great pity that my friend took the little fellow away. We had an almighty spat over our creative differences, after which she stormed off with my most important actor... and now they are gone. *sigh*...
I should never have mixed friends and business. The project failed, and I lost my friend too... In other words, I am doubly defeated.

But that's all water under the bridge — for now, what stands before me but another little Tepetlisaur, starry-eyed and eager for stardom! With such enthusiasm, what could go wrong? We shall make the next big hit!
So, what do you say? If you can help me complete this timeless, groundbreaking work of mine, I'll be sure to reward you handsomely!

dialogue.sit: Well, seeing as {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} likes the idea...
Hundred and ten percent sounds like some kind of scam.

dialogue.t: We can help, but... We still don't know what this film of yours is even about.
Well, here's what I've got so far...

dialogue.sit: *bzzt*— *bang* A sudden flash of dazzling white light heralds the arrival of an uninvited guest to the tribal settlement, perfectly round but for a single spike. *crackle* *bzzt* As it stops for a moment on the grass, a scorching smell begins to waft upon the air. "Eek! An emissary of Xibalba!" The tribesfolk look terrified when they see it. *bang* *crackle* *bzzt* "A foul abomination with no teeth... It's coming our way! It will surely devour us all!"

Just as the wicked villain is about to break through the tribe's defenses... *BOOM* *BOOM* Our savior with the red tail scarf appears, seemingly out of nowhere. "Where did it come from?" the tribesfolk gasp, marveling at its sturdy claws, stronger than obsidian itself, and capable of carving through rock of any kind. "But faced with such a slippery, shameless foe... Surely even for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, this is a fight that cannot be w..."

"Rawrrrr!" cries our savior — in more of a piercing shriek than an angry roar — and the evil, toothless monstrosity begins to pulsate. A raging blaze lights up the sky, followed by a thunderous rumbling... then waves of heat begin to flow forth, hotter even than liquid phlogiston. Immersed in such heat, the toothless fiend is vanquished. "Hot, hot, hot!" cry the tribesfolk, who have narrowly escaped disaster, as the aftershock surges through their ranks.
But when they look up, they discover that their savior with the red tail scarf has vanished without a trace, as suddenly and inexplicably as it first arrived...

dialogue.t: What's up? Need me to run you through it once more?

dialogue.sit: Can you tell me what I have to do again?

dialogue.t: First, set out the performance props. Place the Wooden Barrel in the <color=#00E1FFFF>middle of the scene, without blocking the main character or the set</color>, and place the Elemental Bait near <color=#00E1FFFF>where the antagonist enters from</color>.
When it's time to do so, <color=#00E1FFFF>guide the antagonist to a spot near the Wooden Barrel</color>, then move back to a safe position and <color=#00E1FFFF>smash the Wooden Barrel</color>.

When the actors are in position, the two of you must <color=#00E1FFFF>guide the antagonist towards the Wooden Barrel</color> as planned, then scram with equal haste. Once you've reached a safe position, simply <color=#00E1FFFF>smash the Wooden Barrel</color>.
Hey! Why's a temp suddenly filling in as the antagonist? Nobody ran it by us!
Shh! Quiet, we're about to start shooting!
"No, such evil cannot be forgiven... rest in peace, my friends. Oh, the agony... Seeing the fallen brothers of the tribe, how can one not be moved to tears?"
"But now is not the time for tears. Today, I face the all-scor{RUBY#[D]Xolotl}ching emissary, and come what may, I shall have my revenge—"
A ferocious, toothless beast whose demeanor is as cool and composed as a Lavender Melon, that legendary fruit from far across the sea!
What sort of a face was it, I hear you ask? A visage of such merciless cruelty that even gulping down volcanically spicy Tatacos would leave it unmoved. Truly terrifying...

"This time, this time your remorse shall be great indeed!" And with that, the giant beast with the red tail scarf unleashed the Mighty Meaty Fireball it had honed through countless hours of practice...
Alright, now's the time! Lure the Electro Slime towards the Wooden Barrel, then smash it to smithereens!
What, just smash a barrel? How's that gonna make anyone buy this whole "Mighty Meaty Fireball" business?
Sounds kinda weird, but... If you say so, we'll give it a try.
Rawr! Raaaawrrr!
Steady on, no need to rush!
To tell you the truth, I was just a teeny-tiny bit worried for the little one just now. I wanted the effect to be as realistic as possible, so I might have gone a bit overboard on the explosives...

dialogue.sit: Nearly blew the whole settlement sky high...
Even for me, that felt a bit too dangerous.

dialogue.t: Rawrawrawrawrawr...
In any case, with this experience to go on, I'll know how to do things better next time. Thank you all for your help. Now, how about we take a look at how it turned out?

dialogue.sit: To all of your surprise, neither the savior with the red tail scarf, nor the evil crackling antagonist, nor the thrilling shots of explosions seem to have made it into the final cut — only close-ups of Akatanga's constantly changing expressions...

dialogue.t: I... I'm the star of the show?

dialogue.sit: Have you... used a Kamera before?

dialogue.t: No, no, that's not right! Could it be that the Kamera...
Well, it's true that this is the first time I've ever officially used a Kamera, but... Surely I didn't... get it the wrong way round?
Easy for you to say, but what about all that hard work we just put in?
Wooo... Rrrooo... Rrawrr...
And {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} was so looking forward to seeing it...

I'm so sorry, it's all my fault! Alright, how about this... Just think of the previous events as a rehearsal. We'll do it again, and this time, it'll be the real deal. I'll do my absolute best, and everything possible, to shoot the best film I can possibly shoot!
Rrrooo... Rawrrrr!
Seems like you're eager to give this another shot, huh, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Let's do it, then. Hope nothing goes wrong this time...

dialogue.sit: You follow the same process as before and finally get the result you wanted...

dialogue.t: Incredible! Absolute perfection! That completely and utterly exceeded my expectations.

dialogue.sit: A complete, utter, absolute... piece of cake.
Director, where's that bonus you promised us?

dialogue.t: Aside from the payment we agreed upon, I'll also give you this picture to keep as a souvenir. *sigh* I must say, this really has turned out to be my magnum opus. Of course, I couldn't have done it without your help.
Whoa, you look so imposing, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! Not bad at all.
Rawr! Raaaawrrr!
Hehe, looks like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is happy with how it turned out too. Well, all's well that ends well, as they say!
Who knows, perhaps that friend of mine might even have a change of heart once she sees this... Haha.
No, that won't do. It didn't turn out how I imagined at all... Let's start over.

quests.description: It’s time you shot a film starring your Saurian companion!
